mechanism: Zoledronic acid can cause renal impairment and electrolyte abnormalities that may potentiate pramipexole's renal clearance issues and CNS effects; pramipexole may worsen hypotension that can occur with zoledronic acid infusions.
action: Monitor renal function closely, maintain adequate hydration during zoledronic acid infusions, and assess for orthostatic hypotension and CNS adverse effects; adjust pramipexole dosing if renal function deteriorates.
